rationale_bullets: Szarka: 80.6 on 143 snaps (73.3 MWC-adj); 1,294 @ 62% (9-5) + 922 rush with an MWC-leading 13 rush TD; first FBS QB since Lamar Jackson with 3 straight 200-pass/100-rush games.
Broken wrist ended his season; both prints report 100% recovery - 'first time in 4 years they have an experienced starter back.'
Johnson (72.1/39, 4 starts) is a proven option backup; Hodges stays at FB.
32: elite small-sample scheme fit; just below UNM 34 (Layne's 438-snap volume), above Miami 30.
Allen returns as a proven Superback lead: 73.3/132 (64.4 adj), 750 @ 5.7, five 100-yard games.
The position averaged 2,063 yards '21-'23 - system production is structural; Hodges (245-lb QB convert) and the TB committee fill in.
Carson (66.8/89) and dual-role Harris graduated - 'they have gone through this type of attrition before' (PS).
22: proven lead + guaranteed volume, no proven depth.
The RECV-p97 trio departs (Harris 584 @ 16.7, Fleischmann 370 @ 17.6, Q.Smith 358 @ 23.9).
Dawson's 80.7 on 66 routes (77.0 adj; 21.7 ypc) is elite-efficiency, tiny-volume - the shot-play role continues.
At 80% run the receiving bar is low and blocking is the job (RBLK p96 culture); PS notes MORE receiving yards return than last year.
14: two-deep of 1-start bodies behind one efficient returner.
Six returners with tape led by Vonderhaar (85.7/297 -> 75.6 adj - the best returning OL tape of the MWC round) + Ashford (76.9/187) + Elwood (10 st) + Falk/Tarascio (17 games each L2Y).
Losses are real (All-MWC Burnett 82.0/672, C Cooley 789, Tate 639) but 'The Diesel' reload is documented culture (2023: lost an AA G + 1st-Tm LT, still paved #2-FBS rushing).
RBLK p96 as-played.
26 = top of the MWC-round OL tier with UNM 24/Nevada 22; below CMU/WMU 28.
Zdroik (90.4/515 - the team's best defender), Swartz (438), Adams (379), Grobe (304) all graduated; 'the top 3 are all gone.'
Hubert anchors what's left: 77.3/564 (75.1 adj), 11 st, 11.5 TFL at the RUSH hybrid.
The interior is academy juniors: Tillett (54.6/228), Rawls (55.0/211), DNP Williams, 2-game Barnett - 'inexperienced... does not take transfers.'
14 L: one real edge + an unknowable interior.
Fletcher: 108 tackles, 2nd-Tm All-MWC on 702 snaps (63.4 -> 58.7 adj) - volume production over grade quality.
Daley (64.7/407, 6 st) + committee depth: 'eight different LBs started and 7 return - the polar opposite of the last two years.'
Hubert counted in the DL room per PFF position.
20: proven tackle machine + returning depth; below UNM's 44 duo by a mile.
Eight starters return from a COV-p1 unit - the worst coverage tier in FBS, earned largely by true freshmen (Mustell 10 st + 3 INT, Perez 5 st).
Jones (12 st, 76 tkl, 2 int - 4th-Tm MWC per PS) leads; Mustell's 70.9/588 is the room's best tape and the future.
PS's youth-curve case ('grow in leaps and bounds') vs the tape's verdict: returning-starter count says 24, grades say 12 - split at 18.
Only loss: Levi Brown (65.4/334).
